step-1.text: Stand one thick side panel on its edge, holes in. Screw in four cam pins at the ends, and tap two dowels into the holes for the long shelves.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins and 2 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Push one of the thick end panels onto the low pins, then lock it with two cam locks, arrows toward the pins, turned clockwise.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: Tap dowels into the panel below, two per divider, and stand the two short dividers on them. They set the cube width, so push them fully home.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 dividers and 8 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Lower a long shelf onto the divider dowels and the side dowels at the same time. Wiggle it down evenly, a little at each end.

step-5.text: Dowels, then dividers. Line them up over the ones below.

count-5.text: This step uses 2 dividers and 8 wood dowels.

step-6.text: Top end panel onto its pins and the top dowels. Lock two cam locks.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-7.text: Pins into the ends of the top and bottom, dowels into the long shelves, then press the second side on and lock the last four cam locks.

count-7.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins, 2 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-8.text: Screw the wall bracket to the top at the back, then into the wall with fixings for your wall. Fill the bottom cubes first and the top ones last. And always anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your CASABLANCA 6-cube organizer bookcase is built. Give it a proud little pat.
